name: io.github.tonyyang0504/sticker_mule-mcp
description: Sticker Mule API (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, create_order. Every tool maps to a docume

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_STICKER_MULE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Personal API key generated under Account settings > Store settings on stickermule.com (shown once; personal accounts only, not team accounts), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It can place orders on the saved payment methods.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_STICKER_MULE_PAYMENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: paymentId for create_order: a saved payment method id from GET /api/payments (not mapped). Orders are charged to it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_STICKER_MULE_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: ISO 4217 currency for list_products prices (the `currency` query parameter; Sticker Mule defaults to USD).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_STICKER_MULE_LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: Locale for product names and prices in list_products (the `locale` query parameter; default en).
